evidence.local_verification: 459 tests / 459 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped; deterministic synthetic demo; real-mode error handling and credential redaction verified
evidence.p0_5_reason: P0 proves internal correctness but not real-world robustness or data-network viability. P0.5 must use a deliberately high-identifiability primary corpus where agent, task, model/configuration provenance, execution correlation and outcome are sufficiently observable for clean falsifiable hypotheses. Messy cases are a separate robustness set, not training ground truth. P0.5 passes only if complete economic labels are obtainable for a useful subset OR the high-confidence non-monetary corpus is demonstrably learnable and has a defensible later calibration path to economic labels.

billing_evidence_policy.github_only: Report observable outcomes/retries/waste and data gaps; never claim total dollars or total cost per outcome without monetary evidence. Retain as a learning row only when hypothesis-critical labels satisfy the identifiability gate.
billing_evidence_policy.partial: Compute only evidenced spend, label coverage and partiality, never extrapolate missing components. May serve partial economic calibration only when attribution is defensible.
billing_evidence_policy.complete: Only complete evidenced and attributable components may be labeled total measured economic cost and total cost per successful outcome.

corpus_policy.primary: Small high-confidence corpus first. Prefer explicit agent/tool identity, recoverable task class, explicit or strongly constrained model/provider/configuration with provenance/confidence, defensible execution correlation, observable outcome and known completeness flags.
corpus_policy.secondary: Messy ambiguous repositories test abstention, pagination, failures and robustness only; do not promote ambiguous labels to ground truth.
corpus_policy.unknowns: Unknown remains unknown. Inferred model/configuration labels must carry provenance/confidence and never be treated as measured fact.

viability_paths.path_1: COMPLETE_ECONOMIC_LABELS: sufficiently attributed complete billing for a useful subset supports true measured total cost/outcome labels.
viability_paths.path_2: LEARNABLE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CORPUS: clean structural labels support useful hypotheses even without complete billing, but a concrete economic calibration source (billing-labeled subset, prospective instrumentation or provider adapters) must be demonstrated.

p0_5_target.objective: real-world robustness plus identifiable economic-or-learning viability gate

p1_target.objective: installable GitHub App prototype AFTER P0.5
requirements: under-five-minute target when sufficient history is available
